description: Each invoice's cost gap is the mean of the per-line ratios (product cost − total cost) ÷ total cost.

a.request: For each invoice number in the invoice line items, compute the average `product_quantity` and the average over its lines of (`derived_product_cost` − `derived_total_cost`) ÷ `derived_total_cost`. Keep only invoices whose average quantity is above the average of all the invoices' average quantities, and list the invoice number, its average quantity, that cost ratio, and how far its average quantity is above that overall average. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest (missing last), show the top 10, and don't round. Ignore missing values in averages.
a.sql:
WITH line_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL) AS qty,
    (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0) AS cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
),
invoice_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(qty) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG(cost_ratio) AS avg_cost_ratio
  FROM line_metrics
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg_quantity
  FROM invoice_metrics
)
SELECT
  im.invoice_number,
  im.avg_quantity,
  im.avg_cost_ratio,
  im.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_quantity AS quantity_difference
FROM invoice_metrics im
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE im.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_difference IS NULL, quantity_difference DESC
LIMIT 10;

b.request: For each invoice_number in Invoice_Line_Items, compute the average of the numeric product_quantity values and the mean of the per-line ratios (derived_product_cost − derived_total_cost) ÷ derived_total_cost as the gap, keep invoices whose average quantity exceeds the mean of all invoices' average quantities, return invoice_number, average quantity, gap, and the difference from the overall mean, sort by that difference descending with NULLs last, take the top 10, do not round, and ignore NULL values
b.sql: WITH qty AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL AND product_quantity <> '' AND product_quantity NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS mean_avg_quantity FROM qty), gaps AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / derived_total_cost) AS gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost <> 0 GROUP BY invoice_number) SELECT q.invoice_number, q.avg_quantity, g.gap, q.avg_quantity - o.mean_avg_quantity AS difference FROM qty q CROSS JOIN overall o LEFT JOIN gaps g ON g.invoice_number = q.invoice_number WHERE q.avg_quantity > o.mean_avg_quantity ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

c.request: For each invoice in the invoice line items, find its average `product_quantity` and its relative gap between product cost and total cost, i.e. (`derived_product_cost` − `derived_total_cost`) ÷ `derived_total_cost`. Keep only invoices whose average quantity is above the average of all the invoices' average quantities, and list the invoice number, its average quantity, that relative gap, and how far its average quantity is above that overall average. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest (missing last), show the top 10, and don't round. Ignore missing values in averages. Each invoice's cost gap is the mean of the per-line ratios (product cost − total cost) ÷ total cost.
c.sql: WITH line_q AS (SELECT invoice_number, CAST(product_quantity AS REAL) AS qty, (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items), inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(qty) AS avg_qty, AVG(ratio) AS cost_gap FROM line_q GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS overall_avg FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_qty AS average_quantity, inv.cost_gap AS relative_gap, inv.avg_qty - overall.overall_avg AS quantity_difference FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE inv.avg_qty > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

d.request: Each invoice's cost gap is the mean of the per-line ratios, where each ratio is (product cost − total cost) ÷ total cost.
d.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number;
